description: Discover the URLs reachable from a site, optionally filtered by a search term, using sitemap and link discovery.

ignoreSitemap.description: When true, ignore the site's sitemap during URL discovery.

limit.description: Maximum number of URLs to return.

search.description: Optional search term to filter the discovered URLs.

url.description: Base URL of the site to discover URLs from.

name: firecrawl_map
